title: anim-brake (schema "anim.brake/1")
description: data/anim/brake.json: Inferred by the EP with Tools' helper from Animation's file; Animation tightens values.. A shape check inferred from the file (docs/tools/pending/infer-schema.cjs): every key present is required, a key outside is refused unless it starts with an underscore, a number is bounded only below by zero where all its values are, a colour is a hex string; the owner tightens the values. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

enter.description: The enter pose of the skid (a real pose: rule anim-brake-pose).

hold.description: The hold pose of the skid (a real pose: rule anim-brake-pose).

exit.description: The exit pose of the skid (a real pose: rule anim-brake-pose).

lean_deg.description: The least and the most the body leans back, in degrees (the least at most the most: rule anim-brake-order).

decel_ref.description: The deceleration (units a second squared) that gives the skid its full weight.

min_w.description: The least weight the skid is mixed in at, 0 to 1.

enter_ticks.description: Ticks to mix the skid in.

lead_rate.description: The flight lead's turn rate while braking.

whip.description: How hard the body whips as the brake ends.
